content: Yawé xawatɨriyaya tuki kemɨtiuku'eiri
'Ariketa nekaniuniere, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete waheima muyematsie nekatiniuxeiya 'uweni hepaɨ ti'anekame, tsapiru teteyarikɨ wewiyakame.

Yawé mɨpaɨ tewi rinu matayari manakatɨkɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Mɨxikɨrawita keneutahaki, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wahetɨa muyemanetsie, mana xeimamayari keneutitɨki tɨɨ Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wahixɨapa mukutei, hikɨ keneutaxɨri naitsarie kiekaritsie». Hikɨ tewi muwa neukahani, ne netanierekaku.
Kepauka mɨkɨ tewi meutaha, tukita Kakaɨyari teɨtamete tatsutɨa hepatsie mekaniuti'ukaitɨni, taɨtana yamuyeyewatsie haiwitɨri kanihɨnekaitɨni.

Hikɨ Yawé xawatɨriyaya, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete waheima muyekatei, nanuku'ene tuki kitenie mɨranutakɨkatɨre heima pɨta kaniuyeyerɨni. Tukita kanihɨnekaitɨni haiwitɨri, yamuyeyewatsieta Yawé xawatɨriyaya kanihɨnekaitɨni.
Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama wa'anate tuki takwayaritsie paitɨ kanayu'eniɨriɨkɨkaitɨni, Kakaɨyari Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye niukieya hepaɨ katiniyu'eniɨriɨkɨkaitɨni.
Yawé Mɨpaɨ katinita'aitɨani, tewi rinu kamixayari manakatɨkɨkai: «Tai keneutikwe'i mɨxikɨrawi hixɨapa, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wahixɨapa muyemanetsie». Hikɨ tewi heyaka mɨxikɨrawi wahixɨapa kaniutakeni.
Xewitɨ Kakaɨyari teɨtame yumamá kaniutatsera, tai kaniutikweni wahixɨapa mɨtinierekai, tewi rinu kamixayari manakatɨkɨ kaniukweitɨani. Mɨkɨ 'enukweka kaneyani.
(Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wa'anatetɨa, nepixeiyakai tewi mamaya hepaɨ 'anekame).
Hikɨ nemune'ɨwiyaxɨ, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wa'aurie nekanixeiya naukame xikɨrawime, yuxexuime wa'aurie. Mɨxikɨrawi witsipɨtimerɨkawikai tete kɨritsuritu hepaɨ.
Naukatɨ mɨxikɨrawi yaxeikɨa pɨtiyuxexeiyakai, naitɨ 'axeikɨa muyemanenihepaɨ pɨtiyuxexeiyakai.
Kepauka mɨyeyani, tsepa tatserieta ta'utata tayeta tahetɨa, pɨyɨwekai mɨyeyani ta'aurie kahawautsetɨ. Hakewa Kakaɨyari teɨtameya mu'uya meutaniereni muwa mepekɨkakai, tawariri mepɨka'axekai.
Naitɨ yuwaiyaritsie, yuwarita, yumamatsie, meta Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama wa'anate, metatsiere mɨnauka mɨxikɨrawi, naitɨ hɨxitekɨ mepɨhɨpɨnekai.
Mɨpaɨ netiniu'ena memɨxikɨrawi, «Memɨxikɨrawi» mekateniuterɨwarɨwakaitɨni.

Yuxexuitɨ Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama naukanierikayari menexeiyakaitɨni: mexɨakame Kakaɨyari teɨtame hepaɨ raka'eriekame, hutarieka mieme tewi hepaɨ raka'eriekame, hairieka mieme maye hepaɨ raka'eriekame, meta naurieka mieme kwixɨ hepaɨ raka'eriekame.
Kakaɨyari teɨtamete, nemɨwaruxei haa Kewaxi manuyekatsie, menanukuwɨxɨani.
Kepauka memuhukai, mɨxikɨrawi yaxeikɨa mepuhukai, kepauka memanukuwɨwekai yu'anate mekanitiyuitɨwakaitɨni, yaxeikɨata mɨxikɨrawi mepɨka'ukununuwakai,
kepauka memɨwa'uwekai, mɨkɨta mɨxikɨrawi yaxeikɨa, kepauka memanuku'uwekai, mɨxikɨrawita yaxeikɨa kananuku'uwekaitɨni kwiepa, mɨkɨ memayeneniere wa'iyari mɨxikɨrawi hetsie mɨyetekaikɨ.
Yawé xawatɨriyaya kananuku'ene tuki kitenie mɨranutakɨkatɨre heima, kaniwakeni Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wahetsie.

Ne netanierekaku, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete mekananukuwɨxɨani kwiepa, mɨxikɨrawi wahamatɨa mekanayekɨne mekanewa'uni, Yawé tukieya kitenieyaritsie tau manatineika hepatsie. Kakaɨyari 'Ixaheri hetsiemieme xawatɨriyaya wahetsie kaniuyekateitɨni.
Mɨkɨ memayeneniere mepɨyɨakai, Kewaxi hatɨayaritsie 'aurie ne'uwetɨ nemɨwaruxei, 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya hetɨa. Hikɨ mɨpaɨ nekatinetimani kename, Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama meyɨakai.
Yuxexuitɨ nauka nierikayari mepexeiyakai meta naukame 'anateyari, yu'anatetɨata mepexeiyakai tewi mamateya hepaɨ 'anenekame.
Yaxeikɨa mepɨtehaka'eriekai, Kewaxi hatɨayaritsie nemɨwaruxei hepaɨ. Yuxexuitɨ mɨkɨ yuhɨxima mepuhukai.
